title: Pan-Seared Fennel with Crispy Fried Onion
description: A simple yet flavorful French dish featuring pan-seared fennel and crispy fried onions.
instructions: 1. Slice the fennel bulb into 1/4-inch thick wedges.
2. In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
3. Add the sliced fennel to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until tender.
4. Meanwhile, slice the onion into thin rings.
5. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter in a separate skillet over medium-high heat.
6. Add the onion rings to the skillet and fry until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
7. Season the fennel with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
8. Serve the pan-seared fennel with crispy fried onions on top.
